entities.name: Soldev
entities.description: Independent Kjeldoran city-state of expert machinists in northern Kjeldor, destroyed in the Ice Age.

entities.name: Sorine Relicbane
entities.description: Soldevi branded a heretic for opposing the machines.

entities.name: Arcum Dagsson
entities.description: Soldev's greatest artificer and chief proponent of the machines.

entities.name: Soldevi Steam Beasts
entities.description: Huge steam-venting machines that betrayed Arcum.

entities.name: Phyrexian War Beasts
entities.description: Beasts expropriated by the Soldevi Adnates.

entities.name: Soldevi Adnates
entities.description: Faction that expropriated Phyrexian War Beasts in destroying Soldev.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: Planeswalker whose spark erupted, causing a two-day firestorm.

events.summary: Sorine Relicbane speaks out against the machines and is branded a heretic.
events.quote: He was branded a heretic for his efforts.

events.summary: Arcum's Steam Beasts betray him, joining the Phyrexian War Beasts in destroying Soldev.
events.quote: Arcum's Soldevi Steam Beasts betrayed him

events.summary: Jaya Ballard's spark erupts, causing a firestorm lasting two days that completes the Fall of Soldev.
events.quote: Jaya Ballard 's planeswalker spark erupted, causing a firestorm that lasted for two full days

relations.quote: It was located in the north of Kjeldor
